items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked launch gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior.

Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication, access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct outreach.

Do not retain or admit the proposed CRO control-plane product work in this pass. It is not security-created, delivery is saturated, and execution or integration would require security evidence that is currently unavailable. Preserve only existing security evidence capture and containment work.
